verdict.rationale: Floot's self-hosting doc says you can export an app's code and database and deploy them anywhere. Projects are real TypeScript/React apps, and full SQL dumps are available on any plan. That makes the generated apps self-hostable, but nothing shows the Floot builder itself (editor, AI, managed services) can run on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: self-hostable distribution of the Floot platform itself, a deployment guide for running the core product, independent or hands-on corroboration of exported-app self-hosting.
